method: Every assigned physical page was individually displayed and visually inspected using tools.view_image with detail original, from immutable system Poppler 150 dpi PNGs. No contact sheet was used as a substitute. Equations, titles, table rules, figure text, headers, footers and page transitions were inspected.
layout_findings: No hard layout blocker, clipped mathematics, overlapping page elements, unreadable glyphs or tiny text-only orphan was found. Page 28 is a centered figure-only page, with whitespace expected from the figure float. Diagram text slightly extends beyond rounded boxes on pages 23 and 30 but remains readable and does not collide with other labels.
non_layout_note_sent_to_coordinator: Figures on physical pages 23, 27 and 30 use A_n,Q_n,C_n while the body uses a_n,q(n),c_n. A reader-facing notation bridge was recommended. This record is a visual layout review, not a mathematical correctness certificate.
